assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: full-screen first-person fishing gameplay background, WIDE LANDSCAPE 16:9, ideally 2048x1152.
Input image 1: exact vessel identity/materials reference only. This is a NEW photograph from aboard that same boat, not an exterior catalogue photo.
Primary request: A maximally realistic real-camera photograph of the view a player sees while fishing from this boat on open water. Camera is aboard the vessel looking OUTWARD across the low bow towards open water, level horizon, natural human eye height, 24mm lens without fisheye. No view of the entire boat from outside.
Foreground identity: The reference wooden rowing boat: warm honey-brown weathered oak clinker planks, a simple low curved wooden bow and visible inner wooden ribs, two wooden oars resting along the very outer lower edges. No motor, fibreglass, cabin or metal yacht rails.
Scene/backdrop: broad calm blue-green freshwater with a distant low tree-lined shore and reeds well away in the distance. Natural blue sky, soft scattered white clouds, mild clear daylight, realistic reflected sky and small water ripples, detailed photographic surfaces, natural restrained colour and exposure.
CRITICAL GAMEPLAY COMPOSITION: Horizon at 28-32 percent of image height. Sky occupies top 30 percent. The whole central area from 35 through 69 percent of image height must be UNOBSTRUCTED OPEN WATER where a fishing float will be animated later. Keep ALL boat structure and railing below 72 percent of frame height, mainly in the bottom 25 percent and lower corners; the boat should frame the water, not fill the screen. The central water area is more important than showing a lot of deck. Straight plausible perspective and realistic scale, subtle natural wear.
Constraints: One standalone edge-to-edge photograph. NO fishing rods, reels, fishing line, floats, fish, people, hands, body parts, interface, text, logos, watermark, other boats, marina, pier, graphic borders or collage. No rendering, illustration, cartoon outlines, artificial glow or stylised ocean. Do not carry the catalogue camera angle into this image.
